text:
neha: Merging matmul kernel + q4_0 quant PR to main. Planning a staged smoke on staging tonight in the 22:00 UTC window. deploy-bot will run preflight.

kai: Thanks — quick ask: what are the hard rollback triggers so we can decide pin thresholds? :eyes:

neha: Primary triggers (if any hit during smoke/canary):
- latency.99p increase > 20% vs baseline
- token error rate > 0.2% (parsing/decoding failures)
- eval.mismatch.rate > 1% on the nightly prompt set
If triggered -> immediate pin to matmul-kernel:v1 and abort rollout.

samira: Can you paste the exact deploybot commands we'll run (so oncall can copy/paste)?

neha: Sure — preflight + canary flow we'll use:

```
# smoke on staging only
/deploy staging kernel matmul-kernel:v2 --smoke

# light canary to prod (2% traffic)
/deploy canary kernel matmul-kernel:v2 --traffic 2% --tags canary-210987

# pin to previous kernel if rollback needed
/pin kernel matmul-kernel:v1 --reason "rollback: perf/regression during canary"
```

neha: Telemetry keys to watch: `latency.99p`, `latency.p50`, `errors.token`, `eval.mismatch.rate`, `kvcache.hit_rate`. We'll have dashboards linked in the deploy ticket.

jordan: can we add an automated hold for 30m after canary traffic shift? want a manual go/no-go at 30m.

lucas: ack — I'll be oncall during the window and monitor traces. If anything odd ping me @lucas.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks started for matmul-kernel:v2 on staging. Running smoke suite: smoke-basic, smoke-quant, smoke-kv. ETA ~7m.

neha: If staging smoke passes, deploy-bot will start canary at 2% and post metrics every 5m. Decision matrix:
- 0 alerts AND <=5% 99p delta -> shift to 30%
- Any trigger -> pin immediately and notify release leads

samira: Small release-notes snippet I'll add: "Runtime: matmul-kernel v2 (sha: ab12c3d), q4_0 quant build 2026-03-19 — improves matmul throughput for long sequences; compatibility fallback to v1 available." Keep it short so product can read.

neha: Also note: binary signature changed — ops already uploaded new signature bundle to s3://releases/kernel-signatures/2109876543.sig. Ops will run signature verification before any prod rollout.

jordan: +1 on the signature check. Can we also ensure a hot rollback playbook entry? small snippet:

```
# quick rollback playbook (oncall)
1) /pin kernel matmul-kernel:v1 --reason "auto-rollback"
2) notify #incidents + page oncall
3) open rollback ticket with tracing snapshot and smoke logs
```

neha: Perfect. I'll update the deploy ticket with these commands and the hold window. Plan: smoke @22:00, canary @22:15 (2%), hold 30m, shift 30% if stable, then gradual ramp.

lucas: I'll be watching traces and the eval harness. If eval.mismatch.rate > 0.5% at any time DM me.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 2% (canary-210987). Posting first metrics in ~5m.

samira: Adding a short note to changelog entry and the internal release notes: include kernel sha, quant build id, rollback triggers, and contact list.

neha: Thanks all — will post final confirmation after preflight. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Preflight smoke passed on staging. Ready to start canary when leads give ok.
